JwtBearer._comment_deployed: Base ships no JWT Authority so this edge is deployment-shaped: the dev-only http://localhost Keycloak Authority lives in appsettings.Development.json and appsettings.Testing.json, and a deployed host that sets no Authority fails closed at boot via the platform AssertDeployedAuthorityConfigured guard. RequireHttpsMetadata stays true so deployed environments trust only https:// OIDC metadata; see ADR-0009 item 10.

ServiceAuth._comment_secret: Local-dev only. Production overrides via a secret store per ADR-0010.
ServiceAuth._comment_deployed: Base ships no ServiceAuth Authority so this outbound edge is deployment-shaped: the dev-only http://localhost Keycloak Authority lives in appsettings.Development.json and appsettings.Testing.json, and a deployed host that sets no ServiceAuth Authority fails boot via the AddServiceAuth guard ([Required] + https), because the client_secret and RFC 8693 exchanged tokens POST to the token endpoint derived from it. See ADR-0009 item 10.
